description: Connects a custom domain to a Coreware-hosted website. Adds the A records that route the domain to Coreware infrastructure and the AWS ACM DNS validation CNAME required to issue its SSL certificate. Apply to an apex domain (no host) or a subdomain (host). For apex domains, the optional 'www' group also routes www to the apex domain and validates its SSL certificate.
variableDescription: routingIp1, routingIp2: Coreware load balancer static IPv4 addresses the domain's A records point to. acmValidationName: The ACM certificate validation CNAME host label relative to the domain being connected (e.g. _abc123def456). acmValidationValue: The subdomain prefix of the ACM validation CNAME target, excluding the fixed .acm-validations.aws suffix (e.g. _xyz). wwwAcmValidationName: The ACM validation CNAME host label prefix for the www subdomain, excluding the fixed .www suffix (e.g. _def456). wwwAcmValidationValue: The subdomain prefix of the ACM validation CNAME target for the www subdomain, excluding the fixed .acm-validations.aws suffix (e.g. _abc).
